newsitem.title: USA: Frozen Food sees lower costs in Q2.
newsitem.headline: Frozen Food sees lower costs in Q2.

text.p: Frozen Food Express Industries Inc said Thursday it expected lower costs for fuel to help the company in the second quarter.
"We're now seeing some pretty good declines in diesel fuel prices across the country, which ought to be a help in the second quarter," the transport company said.
A spokesman for the company later said cheaper fuel would help Frozen Food lower its costs.
"It may or may not translate into better profits," he said. "It all depends on demand."
The spokesman said demand for the company's services was low, and Frozen Food could handle at least 10 percent more freight than it did in the first quarter.
The transport company is a carrier of persihable goods, primarily processed foods and meats.
It reported a net income of $0.08 a share for the first quarter against $0.08 a share for the same period last year.
It said higher fuel prices contributed to a cut in its profit for the period.
